content: Ecto isolated migrations per repo: each Ecto.Repo has its own migration directory at priv/REPO_NAME/migrations by default (configurable via :priv key). Each repo can have its own migration tracking table name via :migration_source config (default 'schema_migrations'). Ecto.Migrator.run/4 accepts a specific repo and migration source path. Ecto.Migrator.with_repo/3 handles repo startup for isolated repos not in the main supervision tree. Per-projection repos need: own Repo module, own priv/projections/MY_PROJECTION/migrations/ dir, own migration_source table name (e.g. 'projection_order_read_model_migrations'), and can be run independently.
